title: Attempting vibe coding a project in 7 days
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
So I decide I'm going to give it a go and fully vibe code a game from scratch 

  
Plan or action 

 day 1 fully implementing documentation from planning

Architecture 

Contraints 

Game loop 

Sdk implementation   
Day 2 sscaffolding the project and manager scripts   
Day 3 implement the core loop

Day 4 implement ui 

Day 5 set up tests and start adding sdk bridge 

DAy 6 stress test 

Day 7 bug hunting and fixing 

Lets see how this project turns out:D

comments.author: YKLKTMA
comments.body: It has been proven many times that in a few days you can only create slop

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body: well let me see how a 7 day slop project turns out with good planning and with 2 years  experience   building games  knowing how to actually manual code:D

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body: im anyways a bit burned out from my current games development, so to take a small break from it and relax is a good thing , it lets me also now see what ai is capable of while i prototype something if got stuck in my head and test new systems :)

comments.author: tabaxi_gf
comments.body: Just make a prototype of the gameplay you want immediately and build out from there. If you plan too much upfront and end up changing all that planning is just a waste of time you could have spent trying something

comments.author: finalforge1855
comments.body: Stop with these “make X in 7 days” challenges. They’re depressing, and all you’re going to produce is rushed slop. I don’t even want to imagine how bad the art assets are going to look.

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body:
What do you expect from 7 days?  Gta vi?????? 

Jesus if you read my above comments you would have seen I'm doing this to take a break from my actual game that I'm gettung burnt out on 

So to try out to see what I can achieve in 7 days while relaxing is a fun side project

replies.author: finalforge1855
replies.body:
Okay, fair. I think a lot of people are pretty tired of hearing this kind of pitch after the last two years. But I absolutely respect that you decided to try building something yourself instead of only complaining about boring games. Good luck with it.

If you really have a strong idea, I honestly hope you turn that 7day challenge into a month, seven months, or however long it actually needs. Spend more time working through the details. We really don’t need to watch another rushed prototype get cranked out just to hit an arbitrary deadline.

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body: yea thanks ,im not expecting much to be honest , mostly this is just a small experiment to show myself how much 2years of manual learning game dev with trial and error pays off in vibe coding a prototype game :)

replies.author: finalforge1855
replies.body: That’s awesome. A lot of AI products and tools are trying to solve the same problem right now. I’m researching this space too, which is actually why I’m here. Looking forward to seeing your early results.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
OK so I see people saying , building in 7 days and so forth produces slop 

So tell me why is there so many 7day ,2week game jams heck theres even shorted game jams!!!? 

Is every single game made then slop? 
Does none of them serve any purpose ? 

This is a side interest project 
If I want to devote only a week to something so be it.

Let me cook and see what comes out from this
